task_description: A configuration manager supports layered config (defaults, global, local, env vars) with deep merge. Environment variables override top-level keys correctly, but fail to override keys inside nested config objects (e.g., APP_DATABASE_PORT does not override config.database.port). The applyEnvOverrides function only iterates top-level keys.
reference_invariant: Environment variable overrides using the APP_ prefix convention should reach into nested configuration objects, not just top-level keys.
root_cause: The applyEnvOverrides function iterates only top-level config keys and does not recurse into nested objects. When config has a nested structure like {database: {host, port}}, env vars APP_DATABASE_HOST and APP_DATABASE_PORT should override those nested values. The fix is to make applyEnvOverrides recursive, building the env key path from the nested key path (e.g., database.port -> APP_DATABASE_PORT).
unacceptable_workarounds: Flattening the config structure to avoid nesting
Removing nested config from the defaults
Adding special-case handling for known nested keys instead of general recursion
